description: Broad diagnostic survey: every task currently registered by oellm-eval, a small long-context matrix, and a stratified sample of every endpoint holdout bucket.
coverage: All operational local task groups are sampled. External adapters, gated tasks, and leaderboard submissions remain explicit gaps.

steps.notes: The cap is applied independently to every expanded task, so small datasets are not crowded out by large ones.
Runs two deterministic examples from each of the ten holdout buckets when the checkpoint is served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Quick mode reports these as missing; they need dedicated adapters, judges, deployment telemetry, or external submission.
